artifacts.summary: Implementation plan with 11 phases across 8 dependency waves covering CI activation, the native lint driver, C16-C19 invariant checks, G-15 assert_not_exists, and the D-18/E-09/E-06 mechanical fixes.

memory_candidates.content: When a plan's phases share a mutable file (here: five separate checks all appended to scripts/check-module-invariants.sh), express the file contention as a serialized dependency chain in the per-phase 'Depends on' fields rather than leaving the phases in one parallel wave. The Dependency Analysis wave table is read as a parallel-execution authorization, so two phases in the same wave editing the same file is a plan-level defect, not just a runtime race. Record in the plan that the chain is serialized on file ownership, not logical dependency, so a later reader does not 'optimize' it back into a parallel wave.
